title: Terrazzo
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of terrazzo: stone and glass chips of many sizes set in a cement matrix and polished flat. Use for floors, counters, stairs and wall panels.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python terrazzo.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: chips
parameters.meaning: Number of chips on the tile.

parameters.name: smallest
parameters.meaning: Smallest chip radius in texture units.

parameters.name: largest
parameters.meaning: Largest chip radius in texture units.

parameters.name: angularity
parameters.meaning: How jagged the chip outlines are (0 rounded pebbles, 1 sharp shards).

parameters.name: polish
parameters.meaning: Surface finish from honed (0) to polished (1).

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: White cement with mixed grey, black, rust and white marble chips.

presets.name: venetian
presets.description: Warm matrix with large, dense marble chips in reds and creams.

presets.name: pastel
presets.description: Pink matrix with sparse pastel chips.

presets.name: noir
presets.description: Charcoal matrix with white and grey chips.

presets.name: glass_honed
presets.description: Grey matrix with green and blue glass shards, honed.

limits: Chips are random polygons that may overlap; real terrazzo is packed by casting and grinding. Chip colours are flat with slight variation and no internal veining. Relief is very shallow. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate.
technique_references: Irregular polygon stamps from interpolated vertex radii
Log-uniform size distribution painted largest first
Fine speckle and pores in the matrix
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
